import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep (by Sleep Disorder)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
for disorder in data['Sleep Disorder'].unique():
    if pd.isna(disorder):
        subset = data[data['Sleep Disorder'].isna()]
        ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
                   alpha=0.6, s=100, label='No Disorder', color=colors[0])
    else:
        subset = data[data['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]
        ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
                   alpha=0.6, s=100, label=disorder, color=colors[1])
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(fontsize=8)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax2.hist(data['Age'], bins=15, color=colors[2], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 3. BMI Category Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = data['BMI Category'].value_counts()
ax3.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors[:len(bmi_counts)], startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Physical Activity vs Stress Level
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
scatter = ax4.scatter(data['Physical Activity Level'], data['Stress Level'], 
                     c=data['Sleep Duration'], cmap='viridis', s=100, alpha=0.6, 
                     edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax4.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax4)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Duration', fontsize=8)
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 5. Daily Steps by Occupation
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
occupation_steps = data.groupby('Occupation')['Daily Steps'].mean().sort_values()
ax5.barh(range(len(occupation_steps)), occupation_steps.values, color=colors[3], alpha=0.7)
ax5.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_steps)))
ax5.set_yticklabels(occupation_steps.index, fontsize=8)
ax5.set_xlabel('Average Daily Steps', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Average Daily Steps by Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 6. Heart Rate Distribution by Gender
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
data.boxplot(column='Heart Rate', by='Gender', ax=ax6, patch_artist=True)
ax6.set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Heart Rate by Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.sca(ax6)
plt.xticks(fontsize=9)
plt.suptitle('')

# 7. Sleep Disorder Prevalence
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
disorder_counts = data['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('No Disorder').value_counts()
ax7.bar(range(len(disorder_counts)), disorder_counts.values, 
        color=colors[:len(disorder_counts)], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax7.set_xticks(range(len(disorder_counts)))
ax7.set_xticklabels(disorder_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax7.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Sleep Disorder Prevalence', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 8. Correlation Heatmap
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1:])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = data[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0,
            square=True, ax=ax8, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
ax8.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Numeric Variables', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.setp(ax8.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
plt.setp(ax8.get_yticklabels(), rotation=0, fontsize=9)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
